replies.author: Atheyna
replies.body:
Im sorry, But the judges for the map building contest have decided to deny your map for the following reasons:

- Its really small! I don't find that there is much room for PvP space at all. In addition to that, there are multiple holes in the map, then kinda ruin it
- Spawn structures are small and plain. You barely have any room to move around in the spawns, as in like 2 blocks to move around. The spawn isn't aesthetically pleasing whatsoever.
- Most, if not all Nexus maps have a border, or a wall preventing players from falling into the void. Having this, increases gameplay so so much, and it overall makes the map better. Unfortunately, you have failed to provide this in your map.
- Despite all of those negatives, I do like the idea you had in mind, it just needs to be formed into something of more complexity.  

Aesthetics -  2/5
Gameplay - 1/5 
Creativity -  2/5

Thank you for submitting your map! I hope you participate in our next building competition!
